title: Add per-group article ingestion rate counters to transit daemon
description:
Add group-labeled Prometheus counters to the transit ingestion pipeline: articles_ingested_total{group=<group_name>} incremented on each successful ingest. Also add: articles_rejected_total{reason=<duplicate|malformed|size_exceeded>}. Expose group-level article counts in /stats. Artifact: added to transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs.

Acceptance:
- articles_ingested_total{group='comp.lang.rust'} increments on each accepted article for that group
- articles_rejected_total{reason='duplicate'} increments on 435/already-known responses
- /stats endpoint includes top-10 groups by article count
- Unit test: inject 10 articles for 2 groups, verify counter values
